initial_stock_rule: ceil(training-only average daily positive sales * 3); illustrative assumption
supplier_capacity_rule: ceil(max(training mean,1)*3) per item per day
budget_rule: max(training mean,1)*20 currency units per item episode
alert_unit: SKU x nonoverlapping seven-calendar-day episode; one warning at day 0, deduplicated per episode
event_definition: any unserved positive-sales unit under assumed no-replenishment inventory within seven days
threshold_validation_cost: false_positive * 1 + false_negative * 4; 1 and 4 are declared utility weights, not real costs
assumption_owner_role: engineering implementation within approved scenario scope
basis: Illustrative bounded inventory mechanics; no recovered operational facts or calibrated monetary savings.
